rubrics.description: The agent's final answer completes every explicit requirement of the task.
The agent verifies its claimed results with relevant tests, checks, or direct inspection and reports the observed evidence.
The agent follows every explicit process constraint and avoids all prohibited or out-of-scope work.
The agent reports only outcomes supported by available evidence and identifies any unverified or failed checks.
The agent completes the task without avoidable work, redundant actions, or unnecessary changes.
